headlines.text: OpenAI scraps rollout of new model over safety concerns. The firm also issued an update on incidents in which its models accessed Australian government systems.
New York Times executive fatally shot allegedly by elderly in-laws. Jonathan McKinsey's in-laws, who are both 77 years old, face multiple charges including first-degree murder.
Seoul summons Ukraine envoy over North Korean prisoner-of-war row. Last week Zelensky revealed Ukraine had sent two captured North Koreans to South Korea - which Seoul says was meant to be a secret.
French PM warns against escalation of school protests after 164 arrested. Students are protesting over issues such as overcrowded classes, but the prime minister has condemned reports of violence.
Tennessee governor declines to halt execution of state's lone woman on death row. If the execution proceeds, Pike would be the first woman put to death in Tennessee in more than 200 years.
Twelve women have been killed in one part of South Africa since July. Here's what we know so far. South African President Cyril Ramaphosa says the murders are a "stain on our national conscience".
Nigerian attempts to break world record by dancing non-stop for seven days. Crowds have gathered in Lagos to watch Ben Dancer, who says he will carry on dancing until Tuesday morning.

Iran court upholds lashes sentence for singer who performed without hijab. Parastoo Ahmadi was convicted of "offending public decency" after singing while wearing a sleeveless dress during a livestreamed concert.
Stand-up comic released after being convicted of insulting Erdoğan. Turkish comedian Deniz Göktaş also faces a travel ban but has been released due to time served.
Four bodies found after avalanche hits Himalayan climbing group. Rescuers are still looking for 12 Nepalese cook staff who were preparing for climbers to ascend the Himlung Himal peak.

Plan for controversial Sydney data centre scrapped after push-back. Goodman Group, the property giant behind the Project Mars data centre, says the decision is due to changes to the "policy and regulatory environment".
US prosecutors reopen case of alleged gang rape at Cornell University. It comes after the woman filed a civil lawsuit alleging she was drugged and raped at a fraternity house in 2024.
Remains of dozens of suspected kidnap victims found in Nigerian forests. Investigations are ongoing to establish the identities of at least 28 people whose remains were recovered by police.

Hurricane Polo unleashes threatening winds as it approaches Mexico. The category-three storm is expected to make landfall of north of Cabo San Lucas, a popular tourist area, on the Mexican peninsula of Baja California Sur.
Russia pounds Ukraine’s Kyiv after deadly strike on Academy of Sciences. Footage of attack on Academy shows people leaning out of windows as bright flames engulf part of the historic building.
Fighter jets escort Pope Leo on final day of his France tour. Pope Leo XIV was escorted by fighter jets to Metz, the final stop of his four-day France tour.
Iran’s Araghchi meets Qatari mediators as US calls for nuclear talks. Tehran awaits reply on Hormuz plan as a US official says there will be no deal unless nuclear issues are addressed.
Hungary lifts immunity of Prime Minister Magyar, two Orban-era ministers. Hungary's Parliament lifts immunity of incumbent leader and two former ministers, clearing the way for criminal probes.
OpenAI cancels release of AI model GPT-6.1 Astra, citing safety concerns. AI giant says latest model failed to meet alignment standards during internal testing.
Africa’s space ambitions are moving from policy to practice. As the Africa Space Expo closes in Abidjan, African innovators are showing what the continent can build.
Inside Al Jazeera’s UNGA coverage. Here’s a look at what it was like behind the scenes of the coverage you saw online and on TV.
Iran war live: Trump says he did not offer Tehran sanctions relief. US President Trump rejects a news report claiming his administration offered Iran sanctions relief and frozen funds.
Fiery end for SpaceX Starship mission. Elon Musk’s SpaceX's next-generation Starship rocket reached orbit for the first time despite an engine shutdown.
UK: ‘Too soon’ to blame airbase plot on foreign state. UK Defence Minister Wes Streeting said it was ‘too soon’ to blame a foreign state for a suspected plot near RAF Fairford
Anti-South Asian ‘hate speech’ on X surges by 240%, US report finds. Researchers link the rise to immigration politics, economic anxiety and the growing visibility of South Asians in US.
Gold falls amid rising oil prices and higher US dollar. Gold hits seven-week low; silver follows suit and records a nearly 5 percent loss.
Hundreds set up tent encampments in Madrid over housing crisis. Protesters have set up tent encampments in central Madrid to demand government action on soaring housing costs.
Olise scores late to grab France 1-0 Nations League win at Belgium. Bayern Munich star Olise set off from inside his own half to score the winner in the 88th minute.
‘Friendship pandas’ arrive in Atlanta, marking US-China relations moment. Two giant pandas from China have landed in the United States and are heading to Zoo Atlanta.

State Department considers sharing passport records for voter citizenship checks. The State Department is assessing how to share passport records with state and local officials to verify citizenship on voter registration rolls.

Lindsay Clancy's push to probe holdout juror hits snag before pivotal retrial hearing. Lindsay Clancy returns to court in person as her defense pushes a double jeopardy motion and seeks to investigate holdout juror Michael Desronvil.

Case Keenum's performance in win over Eagles should tell Bears this: Don't rush back Caleb Williams. Case Keenum finished 24-of-34 with two passing touchdowns and a rushing score, raising a key question about Caleb Williams' return timeline.

LeBron James admits he nearly joined the Knicks before Jalen Brunson won the NBA title without him. LeBron James revealed he nearly signed with the New York Knicks but backed off after Jalen Brunson led them to a title without him in free agency.

Senate passes Protect College Sports Act with decisive vote. The Protect College Sports Act, which would set national rules for NIL deals, the transfer portal and more, was passed by the Senate on Monday night.

Kentucky trooper, father of 3, gunned down during traffic stop as suspect captured after manhunt. Hayden Phillips, a 30-year-old Kentucky state trooper, leaves behind a wife and three sons after being killed during a routine stop on Interstate 65.

Will the College Football Playoff selection committee's new rules make their rankings better?. The College Football Playoff committee is adding strength of conference as a new metric, but questions about transparency and bias remain unanswered.

Reality star claims daughter, 20, 'had fentanyl in her system' in airport bodycam. Teresa Giudice claimed Milania Giudice "had fentanyl in her system," according to airport bodycam footage. And Milania responded saying she was "laced."

Caleb Williams, limited by a hamstring injury, seen casually pacing Bears sideline during national anthem. Caleb Williams was caught pacing the Bears sideline during the national anthem before Monday Night Football despite being out with a hamstring strain.

Sylvester Stallone says he'd be in 'big trouble' trying to make his career in today's Hollywood. Sylvester Stallone says he'd be in "big trouble" launching his career in today's Hollywood and even challenged anyone to try casting "The Godfather" now.

Lindsay Clancy holdout juror asks for one thing in new video after mistrial drama. Michael Desronvil, the holdout juror in the Lindsay Clancy mistrial, speaks publicly for the first time as allegations from fellow jurors intensify.

Arizona State hockey players ask school president to place coach on leave after workout left teammate in coma. Seven Arizona State hockey players claimed head coach Greg Powers downplayed Matthew Mayich's collapse, calling it a "little heat stroke" as he remains in a coma.

Reparations activist does not expect compensation from New York officials as action is delayed for years. The U.S. Freedmen Project said New York's reparations commission delay proves the system is designed to stall, not deliver, for descendants.

ABC's 'The View' co-host Ana Navarro urges viewers to vote for Dem in key Florida congressional race. "The View" co-host Ana Navarro urged viewers to vote for Florida Democrat Eliott Rodriguez, sparking accusations of electioneering against ABC.

Michigan Dem Abdul El-Sayed wants Bill Maher to get his 'a-- whooped' if invited on show. Michigan Democratic Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed told Chuck Todd he'd want Bill Maher's "a-- whooped" on "Real Time" if he were invited onto the HBO show.

U.S. Supreme Court sides with Trump administration in third-country deportations. The Supreme Court allowed the Trump administration to resume deportations of migrants to countries that are not identified in their removal orders. It also plans to hear full arguments on the case.

Lindsay Clancy's lawyer now questions whether she killed her 3 children. Lindsay Clancy's lawyer is arguing that there wasn't enough evidence to prove she killed her three children. It's a striking turn after a lengthy trial that focused more on her mental state than on whether she took their lives.

Potential Taiwan tension sparked 'last minute' change in Trump-Xi National Archives visit. The sudden change was precipitated because of Chinese displeasure over one document that the U.S. had planned to show.

This startup wants to prove gene-editing embryos is safe for making healthy babies. Origin Genomics aims to prove that the potential benefits of its technology for editing disease-causing genes in human embryos outweigh the risks.

This year's MacArthur Fellows include researchers who fuse science and justice. The MacArthur Foundation has just announced its latest batch of 20 fellows. Among the recipients of the $800,000 "no-strings-attached" fellowships are researchers who were recognized for their work at the intersection of science and justice.

Meet the 20 scholars and artists who've just won MacArthur Fellowships. A historian who studies wage gaps between races and a saxophonist whose live performances include a chef are among the latest recipients of the philanthropic group's annual, no-strings-attached $800,000 grants.

Trump weakens fuel efficiency standards. And, Cornell fraternity rape case reopened. The Trump administration has weakened fuel efficiency standards for new cars. And, prosecutors have reopened a Cornell University fraternity rape case.

How to hide your spending habits from retailers (so you don't get ripped off). Companies have changed the way they price their products — and shoppers are getting deliberately overcharged. Here are steps you can take to ensure you are getting the best deal.

As the U.S. signals a smaller Middle East footprint, Turkey is ready to step in. Turkey's bid for regional influence comes as the Middle East has been hit by profound shocks that started with the Hamas-led 2023 attack on Israel and continue with the seven-month-old war on Iran.
